snippet.description:
Salute!
AB6IX와 함께하는 챌린G마켓 Ep. 6

지마켓글로벌과 중소벤처기업진흥공단이 함께하는 챌린G마켓!

작사·작곡부터 프로듀싱은 물론 예능, 연기까지! 
다재다능한 아이돌 그룹 AB6IX의 동현 & 대휘와 함께 특별한 콘텐츠로
돌아왔습니다.

영상 속 제품들은 지마켓 글로벌 사이트를 통해 구매하실 수 있어요.

中文 : https://gmkt.kr/tHuXYERf

지금까지 3주동안 AB6IX의 챌린G마켓 사랑해주셔서 감사합니다. 

다음에 또 만나요. 😊

敬礼!
和AB6IX一起的挑战Gmarket Ep. 6

Gmarket Global和中小企业振兴公团一起的挑战Gmarket!

从作词、作曲到制作，当然还有综艺和演戏!
多才多艺的偶像团体AB6IX的东贤和大辉，带着特别内容 回来了。

将为您直接介绍韩国优秀企业隐藏的宝石般的产品。
视频中的产品可以通过Gmarket Global网站购买。

ENG : https://gmkt.kr/tHuXYqtV
中文 : https://gmkt.kr/tHuXYERf

Salute!
ChallenGmarket with AB6IX Ep. 6

ChallenGmarket by Gmarket Global and KOSME!

From lyrics and song writing to producing, entertainment shows, and acting!
We're back with a special content featuring the multi-talented members of 
AB6IX, DONGHYUN & DAEHWI

Discover the hidden gems among products from Korea's finest companies.
The products in the videos are available on the Gmarket Global.

en-US.title: [Challenge G Market] A Mix of Joy and Sorrow at Challenge G Market with AB6IX
en-US.description:
Salute!
Challenge Gmarket with AB6IX Ep. 4

Challenge Gmarket, a collaboration between Gmarket Global and the Korea SMEs and Startups Agency!

From songwriting and composition to producing, entertainment, and even acting!

We're back with special content with Donghyun and Daehwi of the multi-talented idol group AB6IX.

We'll personally introduce hidden gem products from leading Korean companies.

The products featured in the video can be purchased through the Gmarket Global website.

ENG: https://gmkt.kr/tHuXYqtV
CHINESE: https://gmkt.kr/tHuXYERf

AB6IX's Challenge Gmarket
will be uploaded every Monday for three weeks, starting September 23rd.

Thank you for your interest! 😊

--
